name: Zobebah
overview: Zobebah is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Koz. Beyond this unique attribute, the biblical record provides no additional personal details or notable events concerning his life.
namesAndTitles: The name Zobebah appears as a proper name in Scripture without an associated meaning or divine origin. It is mentioned solely in 1 Chronicles 4:8, and no further significance of the name is provided.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Zobebah is the son of Koz, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zobebah's mention in the genealogical record of 1 Chronicles 4:8 situates him within the tribe of Judah, highlighting the importance of lineage in God's providential plan. Though little else is recorded, his inclusion preserves the heritage and continuity of God's chosen people, reflecting the biblical emphasis on family lines as part of redemptive history.
